lines: •Raising 2026 Earnings Guidance Range to $5.35 to $5.55 per Diluted Share
•Establishing 2027 Earnings Guidance Range of $5.70 to $5.90 per Diluted Share
•Issuing EPS Compound Annual Growth Rate Guidance of 8% to 10% for 2027 through 2031, using the 2027 Guidance Midpoint as the Base
Today, Ameren is raising its 2026 earnings guidance range to $5.35 to $5.55 from $5.25 to $5.45 per share.
Further, Ameren expects 2027 diluted earnings per share to be in a range of $5.70 to $5.90 per share, representing 8.4% growth from the original 2026 guidance midpoint.
Ameren expects diluted earnings per share to grow at an 8% to 10% compound annual rate from 2027 through 2031, using the 2027 guidance range midpoint of $5.80 per share as the base.

desk.headline: Revenue up 7% to $2.88bn and EPS of $2.42 beat; 2026 guidance raised, 2027 range set and long-term growth target lifted to 8–10%
results: Revenue rose 7% to $2.88bn; GAAP EPS was $2.42, up from $2.35 (or from $2.17 excluding a one-off 2025 tax benefit).
Growth came from earnings on grid investment and higher Missouri electricity sales in a warmer quarter, partly offset by higher tree-trimming and plant maintenance costs.
Ameren Missouri earned $582m (vs $518m) and Illinois electric distribution $72m (vs $57m).
Nine-month capital spending reached $4.09bn, up from $3.12bn, funded largely with new debt.

guidance.summary: Ameren raised its 2026 EPS range to $5.35–5.55 from $5.25–5.45, set 2027 at $5.70–5.90, and now targets 8–10% yearly EPS growth to 2031, up from 6–8%, backed by a larger $38.1bn investment plan.

points: The bigger plan is built on 2.8 GW of signed power agreements with large data-centre customers, with a further 5.6 GW in the pipeline.
Management called the plan conservative because it counts only signed agreements.
Funding needs rise: planned new equity is now about $5bn, up from roughly $4bn, with about $1.7bn already sold forward.
A lower payout ratio means dividend growth may lag earnings growth; the Missouri electric rate case is not due for a decision until May 2027.
call.source: Call coverage: Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 6 Nov 2026; 24/7 Wall St., 5 Nov 2026

watch: Data-centre customers actually drawing the contracted power.
Timing and size of new share issuance.
Customer bill pressure and the Missouri rate case outcome in 2027.
